Official document (PDF) · Draft S/5483 S/5483/Add.1 · Meeting record S/PV.1084

184 (1963). Resolution of 16 December 1963 [S/5486]

The Security Council,

Having examined the application of Zanzibar for membership in the United Nations, 17

Recommends to the General Assembly that Zanzibar be admitted to membership in the United Nations.

Adopted unanimously at the 1084th meeting.

17 Ibid., Supplement for October, November and December 1963, document S/5478.
